jobs.title: DC Loss Prevention Supervisor: Security & Safety Lead
jobs.description:
The TJX Companies, Inc. – HomeGoods Distribution Center in Fort Worth is seeking a Loss Prevention Supervisor to lead shrink awareness, access control, alarm systems, and security programs across the DC. You will recruit, hire, and train LP staff and develop fire/safety programs with OSHA and NFPA guidelines.

The role requires 3+ years of LP leadership experience, strong investigations skills, and high integrity. Competitive benefits and a starting salary range of $61,000 to $82,100 per year.
